claims.text: Most service businesses take longer than an hour to respond to a new lead.
Faster first response is associated with meaningfully higher close rates.
An outside tester submitting a lead and timing the real response reveals true speed-to-lead.

The Revenue Calculator takes four inputs (monthly leads, close rate, average job value, response time) and returns revenue per lead, monthly loss to slow follow-up, and an annual gain model based on a 10% improvement scenario
